identity.name: Chloe
identity.notes: The restaurant-controlled site and its linked Toast storefront consistently identify the same Chloe at 1331 4th Street SE in Washington's Navy Yard/Capitol Riverfront area. No other Chloe business or location was merged.

sources.excerpt: The official homepage identifies Chloe and links its menus, location, and Chloe at Home ordering.
The official location page gives 1331 4th Street SE, Washington, DC 20003, phone 202-313-7007, and current dinner and weekend brunch hours.
The restaurant-controlled menu hub exposes the current dinner, non-alcoholic drinks, happy-hour share plates, evening specials, and brunch menus with item descriptions.
The Toast storefront linked as Chloe at Home identifies Chloe Navy Yard at 1331 4th Street SE and lists one current Dinner Bundle.
A separately indexed older brunch route contains superseded dishes and naming; it is support-only because the live menu hub carries a newer priced brunch section.
An official restaurant-issued seasonal menu tells guests to inform their server about allergies but provides no allergen matrix, ingredient guide, or item-by-item absence claims.
Targeted domain and web searches surfaced official menu pages and historical menu PDFs, but no official allergen matrix or nutrition/ingredient guide.

findings.summary: Restaurant-controlled and linked-vendor surfaces consistently resolve to the single Chloe at 1331 4th Street SE in Navy Yard.

The frozen 38-item projection reflects an older dinner/brunch cycle and omits current non-alcoholic drinks, happy-hour food, specials, and the linked Toast bundle. The complete current boundary is 59 consolidated products.

The separately indexed /menu/brunch route lists older dishes such as Crispy Churros and Crispy Lemongrass Chicken; the live menu hub has newer priced brunch names and is authoritative for the current boundary.

No official allergen matrix was found after all four required searches. Direct positives are limited to literal restaurant-issued or linked-vendor item names and ingredient terms; no absence or item-level cross-contact claims are asserted.

proposedChanges: Replace the older 38-row dinner/brunch projection with the 59-product consolidated union of the live dinner, non-alcoholic, happy-hour food, specials food, brunch, and linked Toast Chloe at Home surfaces.
Consolidate repeated Fresh Ricotta, Caramelized Cauliflower, Grilled House Bread, Garbanzo Falafel, olive plate, and lamb-potsticker presentations while retaining their service-period surfaces.
Remove six stale frozen products and normalize six renamed or seasonally revised presentations to their current keys.

Publish direct allergen positives only where the restaurant or its linked Toast storefront literally names an allergenic item or ingredient term; mark all other products unavailable because no official matrix exists.
